title: A New Tab page's key hold always ends: keys typed in Cmd-T's own turn reach its field, keys typed after the page was left in the same turn reach the terminal shown, and Cmd-T opens a page again
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab with keyboard focus at its prompt
converted from scripts/cmux-next/newtab-key-hold-e2e.py (nightly 2026-10-11, 'I cannot type into cmux nightly at all'), which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

expect.noReceiptReason: debug.new_tab opens the page and sends each key in one main-actor turn, through the key router's own path; the reply is the opening's record, not an action receipt

steps.note: check 1: Cmd-T and the text in the same turn; the keys wait in the hold until the field reports ready
back to the terminal, as the script's fresh workspace starts

expect.noReceiptReason: debug.new_tab opens the page, selects the terminal tab again and sends each key in one main-actor turn; the reply is the opening's record, not an action receipt

steps.note: check 2: the page is left before it could report ready; within 1 s, well inside the hold's 2 s limit, the held keys reach the terminal shown (the left page ends the hold, not the limit)
script row 'Cmd-T opens the New Tab page after a left page': a held window opened nothing

invariants: at field-typed the focused tab is the new New Tab page and its draft is sha256 of 'hold1', and the terminal's last24Sha256 equals launched's
at terminal-typed the focused tab is the terminal again and its screen holds 'echo hold2left' (last24Sha256 differs from field-typed's), and the left page has no draft
at page-again the focused tab is a New Tab page: Cmd-T works after a left page
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: debug.focus new_tab_key_holds (no window holds keys): no facet records the key hold; the keys reaching the field or the terminal are its visible result
